label: Necessary-predecessor lifting entails no contingent ground of the necessary (inference)
rule: Conjunct projection: the source's necessity is the first conjunct of lifting
meaning: Strength order registration: if every possible supporter of a necessary individual lifts to a necessary, actually present supporter of it, then every possible supporter of a necessary individual is necessary. Same model, support relation and actual world. Establishes neither statement. Strictness: the non-actual-edge model.
